# CALPHAD coverage

13 of 38 systems the project needs have at least one assessed database loaded. A system counts as assessed when a condensed-phase parameter spans its elements (interaction term or compound), not merely when the elements are listed. Each database is graded: full (liquid and compounds), liquid, compounds, or partial (terminal solid solutions only, which does not count as coverage). A ternary with all three binaries covered in one database can be extrapolated (standard CALPHAD practice) but has no ternary terms. Coverage does not mean quality: check each database's tier and header.
